description.value: The Kimberley Heritage Museum is a community heritage institution operated by the City of Kimberley in British Columbia's East Kootenay region. It is listed alongside the public library and arts centre as one of the city's core cultural offerings. Touring cyclists passing through Kimberley — a well-known destination near Kootenay Pass and the Rocky Mountain Trench — may find it a worthwhile stop to connect with the area's storied past.
